note: Who holds which role, by email, kept in the repository on purpose.
Roles are normally handed out on the /profile screen and stored in Firestore, where
only the server can write them. This file is the other half: the people who have a
role before anybody has signed in. Without it the first admin could never exist,
because it takes an admin to make one.
An email here outranks whatever the stored profile says, which is the property you
want from a bootstrap: it is the way back in when a role is removed by mistake.
These are demo accounts. Email and password sign-up does not prove that an address
belongs to you, so anybody who reads this file can register as adm@email.com and be
an admin. That is fine for a demo and is not fine for a real shop: there you put
real addresses here and sign in through a provider that verifies them.
